description: Get the full text/HTML content of a single exhibit from an SEC filing. Returns the exhibit text along with exhibit_type, description, company_name, accession_number, and form_type. Use the maxLength parameter to truncate large exhibits. Find exhibit IDs using get_filing_exhibits first.

maxLength.description: Truncate content to this many characters. Response includes a "truncated" boolean.

name: get_exhibit_content
title: Get Exhibit Content
